gpack_info:
Graphic packs have currently been disabled due to new features and cosmetic changes of Travian Version 4.
We will be working on the improvement of the CSS over the next few weeks, graphic packs will remain disabled until we are finished.
There is no need to worry, we are not removing graphic packs all together, quite the opposite! As soon as we are finished with our work, you will be able to create new graphic packs with more possibilities.
Please do not start creating new graphic packs yet, until we are finished. We will create and release a new master graphic pack once we are finished with our work.
gp_error_firefox:
The graphic pack could not be found. If you use Firefox, this may be due to the following reasons:
  • Path must start with 'file://' or 'http://'.
  • Path must be set to the folder that contains the file 'travian.css' and the folders 'img', 'lang' and 'modules'.
  • For old versions of Firefox (before 1.5) enter the URL 'about:config' and search for 'checkload', then change it to 'false'.
  • For newer versions of Firefox (1.5 onwards) copy the file user.js to the folder
    • For Windows XP: 'C:\Documents and Settings\Username\Application Data\
      Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\RandomEntry.default\      '
    • For Windows Vista: 'C:\Users\Username\AppData\Roaming\
      Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\RandomEntry.default\      '
    • The underlined part is different for each PC.
  • Then restart Firefox.
If you are still experiencing problems, more information can be found here.
gp_error_opera:
Graphic pack could not be found. If you use Opera, this could be due to the following reason:
  • Path must start with 'http://'. Graphics Packs must be hosted online or on a local webserver to work in Opera.

  • For older versions of Opera (before 9.x) there is a trick to use local Graphics Packs:
    • Unpack the Graphics Pack to, for example, C:\Images\.
    • Edit opera6.ini (located in the folder Opera\profiles) with Windows Editor, and go to the section [User Prefs], then type Help Directory=C:\Images\ and save.
    • Now opera:/help/ points to C:\Images\. The path to enter in Travian is: opera:/help/NameOfGraphicsPack/
    • Note that the Opera help will not work any more if you do this!
gp_error_ie:
Grahic Pack could not be found. If you use IE, this could be due to the following reason:
  • The path must be set to the folder that contains the file 'travian.css' and the folders 'img', 'lang' and 'modules'.
gp_error_sonstige:
Graphic pack could not be found. This could be due to the following reasons:
  • The path must be set to the folder that contains the file 'travian.css' and the folders 'img', 'lang' and 'modules'.
  • Your browser does not support graphic packs hosted on your computer and needs them to be online, with a path starting with 'http://'.
